name: Dexxos Participações S.A.
summary: Dexxos Participações S.A., founded in 1929 and based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, is involved in a range of industrial activities. The company supplies thermosetting resins to the Brazilian reconstituted wood panel industry. Furthermore, it manufactures formaldehyde and distributes methanol and various other chemical products. Dexxos also produces tubes for multiple sectors, including construction, infrastructure, and automotive, alongside specializing in steel tube manufacturing for the oil and gas segment. The company officially changed its name from GPC Participações S.A. to Dexxos Participações S.A. in June 2021.
